title: GraphGWAS v0.1.2: relational fine-mapping of causal GWAS variants on a multi-omics knowledge graph
description: GraphGWAS is a graph-native fine-mapping platform that carries multi-omics biological structure (genes, tissue-specific eQTLs, pathways, protein-protein interactions) through the inference as a typed factor graph rather than as flat per-variant annotation priors. Matches state-of-the-art Bayesian fine-mappers (SuSiE, FINEMAP, SuSiE-inf, FINEMAP-inf, SBayesRC) at 6-60x the speed under strong signal, and wins 27-2 head-to-head against SuSiE at weak signal with tissue-specific eQTL priors. This deposit accompanies the Nature Genetics manuscript 'Relational biological structure improves fine-mapping of causal GWAS variants under weak signal' (Estaji et al., 2026). Contents: pre-built graph-database dumps for 1000 Genomes + multi-omics (17 GB) and yeast 1011 Genomes (0.5 GB); benchmark outputs (JSON + TSV) for every figure and table in the paper; Pan-UK Biobank cross-ancestry fine-mapping outputs; figure source data; simulation seeds and per-replicate logs; and a source-code snapshot at the submission tag.
